tess wong: Hi all — first day! Quick: who do I contact for HubSpot seat + shared inbox and Aircall extension? Also need the latest integration one-pager and a short voicemail script.

sam sales-ops: welcome Tess! I opened ticket SO-9133 for HubSpot and AC-9134 for Aircall. For HubSpot we need your full name as in Okta. Shared inbox — which region team?

lee it: @tess wong send your laptop hostname and confirm Okta login. HubSpot SSO often requires you're logged into Okta in the same browser.

tess wong: Sent DM with "Tess Wong" and laptop HOST-TESS-02. Region is sales-west.

carmen enablement: One-pager: https://notion.redwood/sales/1pagers/integrations. Short voicemail script: "Hi, this is Tess from Redwood Inference. Please leave name and number and I will get back to you within one business day." Also pasteable: `Hi, Tess from Redwood. Sorry I missed you, please leave a brief message.`

david manager: Welcome! Week 1: shadow Priya Tue-Fri, quick role-play Thurs 3pm. Aim for first live outreach by EOW. Ping me to book shadow slots.

onboarding-bot: Welcome tess wong! Onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/tess Status: HubSpot (pending), Aircall (pending), HR forms (complete).

sam sales-ops: HubSpot seat provisioned \u2705 — give it ~5 minutes to sync. Shared inbox sales-west created. Aircall queued; extension ETA ~90min.

tess wong: Confirmed HubSpot access, shared inbox works. Thanks everyone!

lee it: Gong auto-provisions after HubSpot SSO; if Gong missing ping carmen.

tess wong: Got it — will follow up if Gong doesn't show up. Thanks :pray:
